description: Deliver reasoning variant to opencode coder sessions via unstable_setSessionModel with provider/model/variant slash-separated id (runner-only)

tasks.title: Deliver reasoning variant via unstable_setSessionModel in the runner ACP agent
tasks.description: In packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts, read the configured variant from with.agent.variant (mirroring agent.model) into AgentConfig/RequestedModel, compose the delivery id as provider/model/variant (or bare provider/model when no variant) inside resolveRequestedModel, and replace applyRequestedModel's no-op setSessionConfigOption primary + fallback with a single best-effort unstable_setSessionModel call ordered before the prompt. On rejection, log a warning and continue (never fail the run). Add variantDelivered and requestedVariant to modelDiagnosticContext. Session-reuse helpers (requestedModelMatchesSession / cachedModelAllowsReuse) need no change because they key on the now-composed requested.model. Rewrite the model-delivery tests in packages/runner/tests/acp-agent.spec.ts to assert unstable_setSessionModel (never setSessionConfigOption), the composed id, rejection tolerance with variantDelivered:false, and session-reuse keying on the composed id. This is a single task because D1-D4 are mutually dependent (resolveRequestedModel is not exported, so the delivery path is only observable end-to-end through acpAgentAction) and tests must accompany the implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentConfig and RequestedModel gain an optional `variant` field; resolveAgentConfig reads variant from the agent sub-object then top-level with (same precedence as model).

resolveRequestedModel composes requested.model as `${model}/${variant}` when a non-empty trimmed variant is present, and bare `${model}` otherwise; empty/whitespace variant is treated as absent (no trailing slash). RequestedModel.variant retains the raw variant for diagnostics.

applyRequestedModel issues exactly one connection.unstable_setSessionModel({ sessionId, modelId: requested.model }) call, ordered before the prompt on the same session. No setSessionConfigOption call with configId 'model' is issued for model application, and the set_session_config liveness activity is no longer emitted for model application.

If unstable_setSessionModel rejects, the runner logs a warning, records variantDelivered:false, and continues the run; the run remains eligible to succeed and the rejection is NOT attributed as the task/session failure reason.

modelDiagnosticContext includes variantDelivered (boolean, present on all call sites that follow an ACP delivery attempt) and requestedVariant (requested.variant ?? null, omitted/absent when no variant configured); existing requestedModel and requestedModelSource fields are preserved. The 'no model configured' early-return log omits variantDelivered (no delivery claim).

requestedModelMatchesSession and cachedModelAllowsReuse are unchanged in behavior but now effectively compare on the full composed id: a cached session established with provider/model/max MUST NOT be reused/resumed when the new request resolves to provider/model/high, and same model+same variant MAY reuse.

Tests in packages/runner/tests/acp-agent.spec.ts are updated: the existing setSessionConfigOption-asserting tests (ModelConfigured_AcpSessionStarts_SetsSessionConfigModelBeforePrompt, SessionConfigModelFails_ModelConfigured_FallsBackToUnstableSetSessionModel, NewSessionCreatedBeforeModelConfiguration_RunnerReportsPhysicalSessionIdToServer, ExistingSharedSessionWithRequestedModel_SetsModelBeforePromptWithoutResume, ExistingSharedSessionWithDifferentRequestedModel_StartsNewSessionInsteadOfResumingOldModel) are rewritten to assert unstable_setSessionModel delivery; new cases cover (a) composed provider/model/variant id, (b) bare provider/model when no variant, (c) rejection does not fail the run with variantDelivered:false, (d) same model different variant starts a fresh session. The fake-agent mock retains a setSessionConfigOption stub only if needed to assert it is NOT called for model application.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner passes with no errors.
npm test -w packages/runner passes (all existing runner tests plus the updated/new model-delivery cases).
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts (variant resolution + composition + single unstable_setSessionModel + best-effort + diagnostics) and packages/runner/tests/acp-agent.spec.ts (rewritten model-delivery tests). No server, Web, CLI, or ACP-protocol changes.
tasks.notes: Implements design decisions D1-D4 (D5 is a no-op by construction). Spec requirement anchors also include #requested-model-id-is-composed-in-slash-separated-form, #variant-delivery-is-best-effort-and-never-fails-the-run, #model-diagnostic-context-reports-variant-delivery, and #session-reuse-keys-on-the-composed-model-id. The variant already reaches the runner as opaque with.agent.variant via the server's generic vars deep-merge (WorkflowDispatchBuilder.ResolveDispatchWith), so no server change is needed. Open questions OQ-1/OQ-2/OQ-3 from design.md are non-blocking and to be confirmed at review/smoke. Manual smoke (issue #190 plan stage with variant:max, checking reasoning_effort=max in opencode logs) is an issue-level acceptance criterion, not part of this code task.
